titleEs: aRPG Timeline vs Last Epoch Dev Tracker — season planning vs dev posts
titleEn: aRPG Timeline vs Last Epoch Dev Tracker — season planning vs dev posts
descriptionEs: Dos tools de tracking distintos. aRPG Timeline para cycle launches y calendars; Dev Tracker para posts agregados de devs cross-platform. Sirven needs distintos pero complementarios.
descriptionEn: Two different tracking tools. aRPG Timeline for cycle launches and calendars; Dev Tracker for cross-platform aggregated dev posts. They serve different but complementary needs.
verdictEs: aRPG Timeline para planificar rotation entre múltiples ARPGs y subscribir al calendar. Dev Tracker para monitorear dev statements daily durante season activa. Players multi-game usan los dos; LE-only players solo necesitan Dev Tracker más durante cycles.
verdictEn: aRPG Timeline for planning rotation across multiple ARPGs and subscribing to the calendar. Dev Tracker for monitoring dev statements daily during active season. Multi-game players use both; LE-only players need Dev Tracker more during cycles.

useCases.reasonEs: aRPG Timeline trackea PoE, D4, LE en single dashboard. Dev Tracker es LE-specific solamente.
useCases.reasonEn: aRPG Timeline tracks PoE, D4, LE in a single dashboard. Dev Tracker is LE-specific only.

useCases.reasonEs: Dev Tracker agrega Reddit, Twitter, forum y Discord dev posts en single feed. aRPG Timeline solo trackea season dates.
useCases.reasonEn: Dev Tracker aggregates Reddit, Twitter, forum, and Discord dev posts in a single feed. aRPG Timeline only tracks season dates.

useCases.reasonEs: aRPG Timeline ofrece iCal subscription para Google/Apple/Outlook. Dev Tracker es RSS-only.
useCases.reasonEn: aRPG Timeline offers iCal subscription for Google/Apple/Outlook. Dev Tracker is RSS-only.

useCases.reasonEs: Dev Tracker captura dev acknowledgements y discussion mid-cycle. aRPG Timeline solo trackea major cycle starts.
useCases.reasonEn: Dev Tracker captures dev acknowledgements and mid-cycle discussion. aRPG Timeline only tracks major cycle starts.

useCases.reasonEs: Countdown timer y date precise ayudan a planificar. Dev Tracker te da hints via dev posts pero menos accionable.
useCases.reasonEn: Countdown timer and precise date help planning. Dev Tracker gives hints via dev posts but less actionable.
